messages:
Maya: Quick check on the onboarding mini-rail we shipped yesterday. Two quick UX nits: CTA copy feels long and the contrast on the subtle link is low. Screenshot in figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc
Rafael: I saw that in the preview. CTA currently 'Start with a sample project' — can we shorten to 'Start a sample'?
Priya: Shorter is better. Also noticed thumbnail images don't have aria labels; screen readers read them as 'image' only.
Maya: Good catch. Add alt like 'Sample project: support chat' etc.
Sam: Ran Lighthouse on the preview. Contrast for the light-link (secondary action) is 3.0:1 at 12px. Needs to be >= 4.5:1.
Rafael: Proposed color swap: change subtle link to #1257A8 and bold the CTA text. That should fix both issues.
Priya: Keyboard order bug: when tabbing, the dismiss X gets focus before the CTA. Users who rely on keyboards miss the primary action. We should move CTA earlier in DOM or set tabindex accordingly.
Maya: Agree. Proposed fix: move CTA button element before the dismiss in markup and add focus-visible outline. Priya, can you verify with VoiceOver?
Priya: On it. Also adding a sr-only header 'Onboarding: sample projects' for context when the rail expands.
ux-bot: Visual diff created for branch onboarding-mini-rail-tweaks (deployed preview: https://deploy-preview.example.com/onboard-mini-rail)
Sam: Preview looks better. Contrast passes and keyboard focus lands on CTA first. Only remaining is micro-spacing on mobile: 10px gap vs design 12px.
Maya: Small spacing tweak and then we can merge. Thanks team :thumbsup:
